run_GTNLoss: run the GTNLoss function to compute sequence-level loss between frame-level inputs and token-level targets
build_GTNLossFunction: build a custom PyTorch autograd Function using GTN graphs for sequence criterion loss computation
create_make_target_graph: create a target graph from a token sequence where each token can align to multiple input frames
test_forward_backward: test the forward and backward pass of GTNLossFunction with batched inputs and targets
review_parallel_for: review how gtn.parallel_for is used to compute loss and gradients in parallel across a batch
